svg.title: Inline and sidecar FLP propagation
svg.desc: Three Envelopes share one Lease. Inline propagation repeats the FLP Set in each Envelope’s unprotected header. In the illustrated sidecar arrangement, the application transports that FLP Set separately alongside the Envelopes. Each FLP remains cryptographically protected in either arrangement.

g.aria-label: Same FLP Set repeated in each Envelope
FLP Set for the shared Lease; Application-specific sidecar
The application makes the FLPs available to the Target Key Service
